exercises.prompt: Identify the case and governing factor of المَسْجِدِ in الطَّالِبُ فِي المَسْجِدِ.
choices: Genitive (majrūr) — governed by the preposition فِي
exercises.answer: Genitive (majrūr) — governed by the preposition فِي
exercises.explanation: The preposition فِي (ḥarf jarr) governs the following noun in the genitive case, marked by kasrah (-i).

feedback.rule: Prepositions govern the following noun in the genitive case (jarr).

exercises.prompt: Select the correctly spelled indefinite accusative form of مَدِينَةٌ ('a city').
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in tāʾ marbūṭah take fatḥatān directly on ة without adding a trailing alif.

feedback.rule: Do not add trailing alif after tāʾ marbūṭah in the indefinite accusative.

exercises.prompt: Match each grammatical case to its primary singular marker.
exercises.explanation: The three nominal cases are marked on regular singular nouns by ḍammah, fatḥah, and kasrah.
